//: Lighthouse CI budgets. AI Search Coding Handoff section 8 sets the targets:
LCP under 2.5s, INP under 200ms, CLS under 0.1, all at the 75th percentile.
INP cannot be measured in a lab run because it needs real interactions, so
Total Blocking Time stands in for it here: it is the lab proxy Google itself
recommends, and a page with low TBT is very unlikely to fail INP in the field.
Real INP must still be read from Search Console's Core Web Vitals report once
Run: npx @lhci/cli autorun   (with the site running on localhost:3000)
scripts/web-vitals-check.mjs measures the same three metrics without the
Lighthouse dependency, and is what CI runs today.
